reason: The migration the finding claims is 'completely absent anywhere in internal/server' is real, just placed where the approved spec (spec-8-change-bootstrap-profile.md, driver D4) puts it: cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh runs a one-time sed rewrite of 'audience: non-developer' to 'audience: casual' on every deploy/install, before the Go server ever reads the file (install.sh invokes sync_skills.sh as part of deployment; FACT-ARCH-001 — 'Deployment is script-driven'). Checklist item correctness-66 only requires the value be migrated in place before anything reads it — it does not require the migration to live inside internal/server. The finding's own evidence ('Grepped the full committed server package ... zero hits') is accurate but irrelevant: the spec explicitly assigns the migration to the shell sync step, not to loadPresentationProfile/newPresentationStore, and the proposed fix (add Go-side translation) would introduce a second migration mechanism duplicating the one the spec designed.

install.sh calls cmd/sync/sync_skills.sh (confirmed via grep of callers), and context/facts/smine.md FACT-ARCH-001 states deployment is script-driven through this same sync script
